name: Filtra Consultants and Engineers Limited
about: Filtra Consultants and Engineers Limited engages in the manufacturing and trading of water treatment systems in India. The company offers membrane, multi-port valve, cartridge, vessels, tank, pump, Ph meter, Orp meter, conductivity meter UV purifiers, high pressure pumps, pressure switch, level switch, and other products used for industrial water treatment plants. It also provides FRP vessels, distribution systems, everest blowers, oil skimmers, corrosion and water proofing solutions, disc filter, astero controller, RO membrane housing, rotameter, water testing kits, resin, filter media, RO antiscalants, swimming pool components, pen type meters/handheld instruments, and accessories for MPV and WTP. The company sells its products through various branches, as well as through its online portal on B2B basis. It serves OEMs and end users. The company also exports its products. Filtra Consultants and Engineers Limited was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Pune, India.
